crossRefs.note: Let darkness and the shadow of death claim it for their own. Let a cloud dwell on it. Let all that makes black the day…
There is no darkness, nor thick gloom, where the workers of iniquity may hide themselves.
Have the gates of death been revealed to you? Or have you seen the gates of the shadow of death?
Even though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil, for you are with me. Your rod and…
though you have crushed us in the haunt of jackals, and covered us with the shadow of death.
Are your wonders made known in the dark? Or your righteousness in the land of forgetfulness?
They didn’t say, ‘Where is Yahweh who brought us up out of the land of Egypt, who led us through the wilderness…
Give glory to Yahweh your God, before he causes darkness, and before your feet stumble on the dark mountains, and while…
Besides all this, between us and you there is a great gulf fixed, that those who want to pass from here to you are not…

translations.web: the land dark as midnight, of the shadow of death, without any order, where the light is as midnight.’ ”
translations.bsb: to a land of utter darkness, of deep shadow and disorder, where even the light is like darkness.”
translations.kjv: A land of darkness, as darkness itself; and of the shadow of death, without any order, and where the light is as darkness.
translations.asv: The land dark as midnight, The land of the shadow of death, without any order, And where the light is as midnight.
